posts.title: Intent UI
posts.description: Intent UI is continuously generative UI: describe what you need and a page is built from your data, generated lazily where you go next, and saved as a document anyone can reload, replay and render with their own components.

posts.title: Wrapping separators for inline lists with CSS
posts.description: ul { text-align: center; padding: 0; } li { display: inline; } li::after { content: " "; word-spacing: 1rem; background-image: linear-gradient( -0.2turn, transparent 0 calc(50% - 0.03em), currentcolor 0 calc(50% + 0.03em), transparent 0 ); }

posts.title: External link icons with CSS
posts.description: a[target="_blank"]::after { content: "\2060" / ""; padding-inline-start: 1em; background: currentColor; mask: var(--arrow) 0 0 / 100% 100%; }
